mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase significantly, it indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to higher consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a stable or decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a growing economy without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS stable or decreases
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
